name: HUD
description: The words of LiD HUD's Enemies Left counter ("Enemies left: 12 / 20") in every language the game has. The counter itself, and the durability numbers on the weapon bars, are drawn by lid-hud.dll (LiD HUD) - see the readme. Without this mod the counter is in English.
author: KSFA
